sections.title: Preference Exchanges
sections.text: Exchanges for preference (color, model, size) are allowed within 7 days, subject to availability of the desired product. The product must be in perfect condition and in its original packaging. Price differences are charged or refunded as applicable.

sections.title: Right of Withdrawal (Online Purchases)
sections.text: The customer may request a return within 7 (seven) calendar days after receiving the product, with no need for justification. The product must be in its original packaging, with no signs of use, with all accessories and manuals. The refund is made through the original payment method within 10 business days. Return shipping is paid by the store in the case of withdrawal.

sections.title: Standard Service Flow
sections.text: Greeting: greet the customer by name (if available) and ask how to help. Understanding: identify the customer's need (product search, question, tracking, complaint). Lookup: search the system for the relevant information (product, stock, promotion, order). Answer: present the options clearly and objectively, with prices and conditions. Closing: confirm whether the customer needs anything else and close courteously.

sections.title: Exchanges for Defects
sections.text: Products with manufacturing defects may be exchanged within 30 (thirty) calendar days after purchase. After 30 days, the customer must claim the warranty directly with the manufacturer. Empório da Música may mediate the process on request. Damage caused by misuse, falls, excessive humidity or unauthorized modifications is not covered.

sections.title: Legal Warranty
sections.text: Under the Consumer Protection Code, all products have a legal warranty of 90 (ninety) days against manufacturing defects, counted from the date the customer receives them.

sections.title: Manufacturer's Warranty
sections.text: Beyond the legal warranty, most manufacturers offer their own warranty, ranging from 6 months to 2 years. Specific terms and conditions are in the warranty certificate that comes with each product.
